kept.title: SQL Injection in User Search
kept.description: The user search functionality uses string concatenation to build a raw SQL query, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL commands into the database query.
steps_to_exploit: Navigate to the user search page
Input a malicious payload into the login field, e.g., ' OR 1=1 --
Observe that the application returns data for all users or allows further command execution.
kept.impact: Full database compromise, including sensitive user data and authentication credentials.

evidence.quote: var query = "SELECT name,id FROM Users WHERE login='" + req.body.login + "'";

code_refs.quote: var query = "SELECT name,id FROM Users WHERE login='" + req.body.login + "'";

kept.title: Remote Code Execution via OS Command Injection
kept.description: The ping functionality passes user-supplied input directly into the `exec()` function without validation or sanitization.
steps_to_exploit: Navigate to the ping functionality
Enter a command injection payload, such as '; cat /etc/passwd #
The server executes the concatenated command alongside ping.
kept.impact: Complete server takeover by executing arbitrary system commands.

kept.title: Insecure Deserialization of User Input
kept.description: The `bulkProductsLegacy` function uses `node-serialize.unserialize()` on user-uploaded file content, which is susceptible to arbitrary code execution through crafted serialized objects.
steps_to_exploit: Craft a malicious serialized payload containing an IIFE (Immediately Invoked Function Expression)
Upload this file to the legacy bulk products import endpoint
The server deserializes the object, triggering the embedded function.
kept.impact: Remote Code Execution on the server.

kept.title: Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
kept.description: The application renders user input directly to the DOM using `<%- %>` in EJS, which does not escape HTML entities, leading to potential XSS.
steps_to_exploit: Supply a script tag payload in a product search query
View the resulting page where the script is rendered and executed in the user's browser.
kept.impact: Session hijacking, credential theft, or unauthorized actions performed on behalf of the user.

kept.title: XML External Entity (XXE) Injection
kept.description: The XML parser used for bulk product uploads is configured with default settings that may allow processing of external entities.
steps_to_exploit: Create an XML file with an external entity declaration targeting sensitive files on the server (e.g., /etc/passwd)
Upload the file to the bulk products endpoint
The server parses the XML and returns the contents of the entity.
kept.impact: Disclosure of sensitive server files and potentially SSRF.

kept.title: Insecure Math Expression Evaluation
kept.description: The calculator function uses `mathjs.eval()`, which can evaluate arbitrary JavaScript expressions if passed certain inputs.
steps_to_exploit: Input a payload into the calculator, such as 'constructor.constructor("return process.env")()'
The server evaluates the code, potentially leaking sensitive environment variables.
kept.impact: Remote Code Execution and sensitive data disclosure.

kept.title: Broken Access Control (Admin Dashboard)
kept.description: The admin dashboard relies on client-side logic and variables passed to the view to hide content, rather than enforcing authorization on the server-side routes.
steps_to_exploit: Access the admin route as a regular user
Toggle the visibility of the UI elements using browser development tools, or simply observe that administrative actions are accessible via API endpoints.
kept.impact: Unauthorized access to administrative functionalities and data.

evidence.quote: module.exports.listUsersAPI = function (req, res) { db.User.findAll({}).then(users => { res.status(200).json({ success: true, users: users }) })

kept.title: Weak Password Reset Mechanism
kept.description: The password reset token is generated using `md5(login)`, which is deterministic and predictable based on the user's login ID.
steps_to_exploit: Identify a target user's login ID
Calculate the MD5 hash of the login ID
Construct a URL using this hash to reset the target user's password without their email access.
kept.impact: Full account takeover of any user on the platform.

kept.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure via API
kept.description: The `/app/admin/usersapi` endpoint returns all user objects, including hashed passwords, to the client-side.
steps_to_exploit: Authenticate as a user
Navigate to the users list or directly call the `/app/admin/usersapi` endpoint
Inspect the network response to see the full list of users with hashed passwords.
kept.impact: Information disclosure of user account metadata and password hashes, facilitating brute-force or offline cracking attacks.

evidence.quote: module.exports.listUsersAPI = function (req, res) { db.User.findAll({}).then(users => { res.status(200).json({ success: true, users: users }) }) }

kept.title: Insufficient Session Security
kept.description: The express-session configuration uses default/insecure settings, including 'secure: false' and a static, publicly known secret ('keyboard cat').
steps_to_exploit: Capture the session cookie
Use the known 'keyboard cat' secret to forge session tokens or hijack active sessions.

evidence.quote: secret: 'keyboard cat', resave: true, saveUninitialized: true, cookie: { secure: false }

kept.title: Open Redirect
kept.description: The application redirects users to arbitrary URLs provided in the `url` query parameter without validation.
steps_to_exploit: Craft a link with the redirect URL pointing to a malicious phishing site
Send the link to a victim user.

kept.title: Improper Input Validation on File Upload
kept.description: The file upload feature does not perform sufficient validation on the file content or size, enabling potential DoS or other attacks via large or malformed files.
steps_to_exploit: Upload a very large file to exhaust disk space or memory.
Upload a file with a mismatching MimeType to bypass logic checks.
kept.impact: Resource exhaustion and possible exploitation of further processing logic.

kept.title: Information Disclosure via Debug/Console
kept.description: Database connection errors and system errors are logged to the console or returned via flash messages that might contain sensitive diagnostic info.
steps_to_exploit: Trigger an error in the application by providing malformed input to a database-interacting form.
Observe the flash message or server log output.
kept.impact: Exposure of database structure and internal application details to an attacker.

kept.title: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
kept.description: The application does not implement CSRF protection (e.g., csurf middleware) for state-changing operations like password changes or user updates.
steps_to_exploit: Create a malicious form on a third-party site targeting /app/useredit.
Social engineer an authenticated user to visit the page, causing their profile details to be updated without consent.
kept.impact: Unauthorized modification of user accounts and settings.

rejected.title: Insecure Use of Development Dependencies
rejected.why: a protection enforced in the code defeats the claim
